reel.caption:
Starting your SIP "next year": why can it cost you ₹6.19 lakh?

Illustrative ₹5,000 a month at an assumed 12% a year for 20 years ≈ ₹49.96 lakh.
Start one year later and stop on the same date: 19 years ≈ ₹43.77 lakh.
You invest only ₹60,000 less, but end up ≈ ₹6.19 lakh lower. The last year of compounding is the biggest one.
Assumed return for illustration; market returns are not guaranteed and vary year to year.
